hero.h1: Your classroom, online and entirely yours.
hero.lead: EduLabs builds a learning platform for you: your own web address, your own colors, set up the way you teach. You teach. We build the site.
hero.addr: is where your students log in.
svc.intro: Start from a platform that already works, then make it yours down to the smallest detail.
lms.h3: A learning platform with your name on it
lms.p: We take our finished LMS template and shape it around your class. Students log in at your own address and see your brand, not ours.
lms.t5: Storage that grows with your plan
custom.p: Tell us the change, even a small one, and we'll build it exactly how you want it. Custom requests are quoted separately, so you know the price before we start.
bk.p: Send us your curriculum and we'll turn it into a polished PDF in your brand. Need a brand first? We can create a name and logo for you too.
how.h2: From sign-up to a live classroom in four steps
how.p1: Choose the size that fits your class and your storage needs.
how.p2: Share your name, colors, and any changes you'd like.
how.p3: We customize our template to match. Custom work is quoted before we begin.
how.p4: Your site goes live at <bdi dir="ltr">yourname.{d}</bdi>.
tch.intro: Every site is built for one teacher and looks like it. Open one to see how a finished platform feels.
tch.joinP: Tell us how you teach and we'll build the site.
pl.intro: Pay yearly and get two months free. Custom changes and books are priced separately.
plan.seed.b: For one teacher and one class.
plan.grove.f: A setup call with our team
ex.p1: Layout tweaks, new pages, special features. Describe it and we'll send a quote.
ex.p2: Your curriculum as a PDF in your brand, priced per book. Brand creation (name and logo) available with it.
bs.h2: Your curriculum, bound in your brand.
bs.p: We'll turn your curriculum into a designed PDF that carries your name, your colors, and your logo. If you don't have a brand yet, we'll create one with you.
bs.ok: You're on the list. We'll email you when books open.
cv.note: Their brand on the cover, not ours.
faq.a1: Your platform on your own address, student logins, and the storage and student limits listed on the plan. Your colors and logo are included from the Branch plan up.
faq.q2: What counts as a custom request?
faq.a2: Anything beyond the template and your brand: new pages, special features, unusual layouts. Even small changes are welcome. We quote each request before starting.
faq.a3: Your platform wears your brand. Books follow the same rule: they carry your brand, not ours.
faq.a4: Soon. Join the waitlist above and we'll email you when we open it.
band.h2: Ready to see your classroom online?
band.p: Pick a plan, tell us how you want it to look, and we'll take it from there.
d.noneP: Start a project and tell us how you want your platform to look. We'll reply with next steps and a quote for any custom work.
